purpose: Numeric finish line for Atramedes 10N bots: per-actor kill DPS on par with a matched Warcraft Logs reference, measured over a batch of native kills in the Atramedes shard (seeded Magmaw + Omnotron lockout, unseeded dwarven-spirit intro and bell).

lockout.unseeded_prerequisites: The eight dwarven spirits (spawn groups 435/436) and the Ancient Bell stay native: the route kills the spirits, waits for the bell to become selectable, rings it and waits for the intro landing.

reference_status.reason: Six Atramedes 10N kills extracted 2026-09-27 (atramedes_wcl_dps_reference_v1.json): MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ fight 32 (round 1) and five round-2 kills of 2024-10 (173.6-199.0 s, raid item level 354.2-357.9) chosen for Balance Druid, Assassination Rogue and Demonology Warlock. Each spec's target is the median of one value per kill.

reference_gaps.with_wowsims_fallback: None: every canonical non-healer spec has a matched WCL value. Thin samples: elemental_shaman (2 kills) and fire_mage (3 kills, parses 14, 52 and 79).

unmatched_reference_notes.xAhkN2y9YP3KRmnJ-fight17: 48.5 s kill at item level 401.4 that ends before the first liftoff (no air phase, no Searing Flame); throughput context only, never a target.

reference_matching_rationale: All six matched kills cover a full ground-air-ground cycle (fight 32 lands at about 129 s; the round-2 kills last 173.6-199.0 s), so every target already prices in the air phase that melee cannot hit and the Sonar Pulse / Sonic Breath movement, unlike the patchwerk WoWSims fallback used in round 1. Fight 32's blood_death_knight value is the active tank only (Greysnout, 13,254); its off-tank Wongelrainer (3,965, 39% active) is excluded because the canonical roster has one tank, and its Survival value is the median of two hunters. The round-2 kills were found through the Balance rankings filtered to raids that also field Assassination and Demonology, then verified on each fight page; their players' parse percentiles range 11-84 for the three wanted specs, so the per-spec median is not a top-parse target. Tank rows of other specs (feral_druid_tank, protection_paladin) are recorded but no canonical actor uses them.
actor_dps_metric: Per actor: mean encounter_window_dps over the label's counted native-clear kills divided by the median actor_dps of the matched references for the same spec. target_dps is that WCL median; the actor passes when ratio >= actor_dps_ratio.
party_dps_metric: Mean encounter_window_party_dps over counted native-clear kills divided by the median raid_dps of the matched references. Reported, not gating; no matched reference yet.

clear_rule.basis: report.json native_gameplay_outcome.native_clear and completion_reason. The harness exit code is informational: diagnostic route runs exit 1 (all_passed=false) even on a clean native clear.

boss_window_deaths_basis: Lethal landed damage on a party member inside the encounter route node or encounter window, reconciled with the route death count. Unknown counts never pass. Dwarven-spirit trash deaths that recover do not gate.

dps_gate_exempt_decision.quote: Just count blood tank as dps, leave feral out. Feral dps is negligible, but bdk is relevant.
dps_gate_exempt_decision.effect: feral_druid_tank DPS is recorded and reported as informational: no parity gate, and a missing reference does not fail the verdict. blood_death_knight stays gated against its WCL reference. This roster fields a Balance druid for Atramedes, so the field is declared for consistency across the BWD 10N targets.

healer_status: Healers have no DPS target; their status follows the encounter status.

fallback_reference.applies_when: the spec has no matched WCL reference
fallback_reference.dps_field: result_observation.dps of the spec entry's generation_receipt; the receipt's sha256 must match the index entry, its target_spec must match and simulator_error must be empty, otherwise the spec has no fallback

reference_basis_rule: Per non-healer actor: reference_basis wcl (target = median matched WCL DPS, required ratio actor_dps_ratio) when the spec has a matched WCL reference; otherwise wowsims_fallback (target = verified WoWSims DPS, required ratio fallback_reference.ratio); otherwise none (status no_reference).
missing_reference_policy: An actor whose spec has neither a matched WCL reference nor a verified WoWSims fallback gets status no_reference and no target. The overall status is fail until a reference exists: a missing reference is work, not a pass. Specs listed in dps_gate_exempt_specs are the exception (user decision 2026-09-27): their DPS is informational, a missing reference fails nothing, and like a healer their status follows the encounter.
roster_source: tools/raid_program/raid_shard_plan.build_shard_plan(blackwing_descent_10n.json, boss atramedes, copy 0): character GUID 10,000,000 + packed index 1003001-1003010; spec selection {druid: balance_druid, shaman: elemental_shaman} (one tank, two healers).
roster_policy: Specs and roles come from this roster, never from the WCL timeline. A counted clear missing any expected actor fails the encounter with roster_incomplete.
duty_policy: Duties are chosen by capability each snapshot (BotAtramedesDutyPlan.h): tank = main-tank lease or the role tank; gong owner and backup = the two best ranged damage dealers by gong rank (hunter, then mage, ...); nobody is bound to a roster slot.

counting_rules.label: A label is one build and one batch: run refuses a label that already has kills and runs a pinned copy /tmp/worldserver-<sha12>.
counting_rules.counted: A kill counts unless it is voided, interrupted, an infrastructure_failure, has no evidence pointer (no_evidence), is a clear whose post-processing failed (postprocess_error), was recorded without report.json measurement_validity (no_measurement_validity), or has valid_for_dps false (stalled_boss_window).
counting_rules.measurement_validity: Copied per kill from report.json measurement_validity for the encounter window (valid flag, reasons, stalled sec, stall fraction, max stall). A clear with valid_for_dps false is excluded; a wipe is excluded only when a stall overlapped the boss window, so trash wipes still fail the label.
counting_rules.damage_reconciliation: Killed-hostile damage vs max HP from combat_analysis.json (mismatch_count, unlogged_health_loss). Shown, never excludes a kill.
counting_rules.infrastructure_failure: report.json missing or unreadable, or the run never reached the encounter route node and no bot died. Not counted and not a gameplay failure.
counting_rules.mixed_builds: Counted kills with different worldserver_sha256 (mixed_binaries) or source_commit (mixed_commits) fail the encounter.

status_rules.encounter: fail if any counted kill is not a native clear, lacks encounter data, has more than max_boss_window_deaths boss-window deaths or an unknown count, or the counted kills mix binaries/commits or miss a roster actor; otherwise insufficient_kills below kills_per_measurement counted native clears; otherwise pass.
status_rules.actor: no_reference without a matched spec reference or fallback; insufficient_kills below kills_per_measurement; fail (below_target) under the required ratio; fail (encounter_failed) at target while the encounter is not pass; otherwise pass.
status_rules.overall: pass only if the encounter passes and every non-healer actor passes.

noise_rule.test: two-sided Welch t-test at alpha 0.05 over counted native-clear kills
noise_rule.statistic: t = (mean1 - mean2) / sqrt(sd1^2 / n1 + sd2^2 / n2), sample standard deviations (n - 1)
noise_rule.degrees_of_freedom: Welch-Satterthwaite: (a + b)^2 / (a^2 / (n1 - 1) + b^2 / (n2 - 1)) with a = sd1^2 / n1, b = sd2^2 / n2
noise_rule.critical_value: t_crit = Student t quantile 0.975 at df (scipy.stats.t.ppf)
noise_rule.within_noise: otherwise; with zero spread on both sides any nonzero delta is improved or regressed
noise_rule.insufficient_kills: either label has fewer than min_kills_per_label counted native-clear kills
noise_rule.applies_to: each actor's encounter_window_dps and the party encounter_window_party_dps
noise_rule.keep_rule: Same keep/revert rule as the Magmaw target: every candidate kill a native clear, boss-window deaths not increased, no party or non-healer regression under the per-row two-sided 95% Welch t, and a non-negative point estimate, each label with kills_per_batch counted native clears.
noise_rule.batch_rule: keep/revert batches use kills_per_batch counted native clears per label; kills_per_measurement stays the finish-line minimum

run_plan.duration_policy: completion-watchdog: stop on native clear, no-progress stall, repeated decisions, death loops or infrastructure loss. There is no success timer.
run_plan.watchdog_note: The route includes two spirit packs, the bell and a ~20 s scripted intro flight before the pull; a 180 s no-progress window covers the intro wait.
